rulings.why: The weakness it cancels is really applied: tsukumogami-poppet carries an effectChoices 'poppet-material' whose metal/ceramic options grant weaknesses [{electricity|cold,5}]. Every IWR field is additive and no field subtracts, so needsEngineWork is correct.
Verified in build.ts (~3061-3068): adept benefits are pushed only for imps.slice(0,2) and the comment says the third implement never gains adept. No field can push an implement benefit.

The gap is real but grantedStrikes CREATES a second Fist row beside the nonlethal baseline instead of changing it — the same objection this judge raised against grantedStrikes for martial-artist-dedication. The lane that already exists is Feat.unarmedTraits (types.ts ~757, applied to FIST_PROFILE by applyUnarmedRiders in derive.ts ~1671/1765); FIST_PROFILE.name is 'Fist', so match:['fist'] hits it.

Removes a -4 penalty on the player's own Demoralize and swaps auditory for visual; not in FEAT_SITUATIONAL, and the identical clause is already delivered for intimidating-prowess (situationalBonuses.ts:237).
The weather is GM-side but the -2 reduction lands on the player's own ranged attack rolls, which is exactly what the star registry displays; no entry exists for this id.
A rider on the player's own successful Fortitude saves, the same shape as cantorian-reinforcement (situationalBonuses.ts:2776); the id is absent from the registry.

Confirmed: ModeDef (types.ts:1432-1495) carries resistances/weaknesses/immunities/senses/speeds but no strikes, StanceDef.strikes needs a core.stances record and 'enter-spirit-trance' is an action not a stance, and grantedStrikes is permanent. Nothing can express a duration-limited Strike.

Gap real, fix wrong: grantedStrikes would add an 'Iron Fist' row beside the baseline Fist that still shows nonlethal. unarmedTraits can ADD shove but has no remove, and the nonlethal strip is hard-coded to fistDieUpgraded (derive.ts:1734-1737, powerful-fist / warrior-automaton / warrior-jotunborn only) — zombie-dedication prints the same 'your fist loses the nonlethal trait' and also carries nothing, confirming the lane is missing.
A permanent degree-of-success upgrade on the player's own saves; not in FEAT_SITUATIONAL, and the same shape ships for cantorian-reinforcement and disillusionment.
Degree upgrade on the character's own saves vs emotion effects; absent from FEAT_SITUATIONAL, and disillusionment (situationalBonuses.ts:2785) is the identical printed shape.
Same clause without the gutsy-halfling rider; the judge correctly omitted that rider, and the id carries nothing.
A separate core.json record with the full text including the gutsy-halfling critical-failure clause; it carries no field and is not in the registry.
Same as irrepressible-ganzi — the printed text has no gutsy-halfling clause and the fix does not add one.

Confirmed against weaponMatches (derive.ts:1265-1274): critSpecWeapons narrows only by group/traits/bases, granted naturals share group 'brawling' with fists/gauntlets/saps and carry no item base id, so any expressible narrowing would over-grant. needsEngineWork is the honest answer.

Gap real, values wrong: the text never says 'trained with' (unlike vanara/vishkanya, which do and therefore use rank:'trained') — it says treat martial ones as SIMPLE, which is mirrorCategory. rank:'trained' would freeze a character with expert-or-better simple proficiency at trained. Ids and categories verified in core.json: bola/greataxe/halberd/maul/war-flail are martial (longspear is already simple, so it is dropped as a no-op); the two jotunborn-trait weapons (bladesweeper, maul-spade) are advanced and cannot share one entry, so the advanced-to-martial half stays out rather than being over-granted.

The difficult-terrain half is GM-side and the fix correctly leaves it out; the off-guard removal plus degree upgrade on the player's own Acrobatics is real and matches brine-may (situationalBonuses.ts:2774).

A degree-of-success upgrade on the player's own Recall Knowledge checks, matching runic-skullcap (situationalBonuses.ts:2607); the judge explicitly excluded the unmodellable permanent-quickened clause rather than inventing a field for it.
'You gain expert proficiency in heavy armor' is unconditional; `armor` is a real FeatGrant field (featGrants.ts) and the id appears in neither FEAT_GRANTS, FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS nor FEAT_LANE_GRANTS.

Verified: featGrantsAuto.ts:192 keys only 'knight-vigilant-dedication'. This is a separate selectable core.json record with the same expert-Religion clause and no grant; the lesser-cover clause is correctly left to the GM.

Shape verified against kobold-weapon-familiarity, which already ships critSpecWeapons {traits:['kobold'],bases:['greatpick','light-pick','pick']}; weaponMatches ORs traits and bases, and crossbow/greatpick/light-pick/pick/spear all exist in core.json. This record carries no critSpec of its own, so nothing is overwritten.

Arithmetic checked: ancestries['awakened-animal'].speeds = {land:5}, and the swimming-animal 'aquatic' effectChoice grants only {swim:30}, so land stays 5. The feat's prerequisite forces the aquatic option, so +15 lands exactly on the printed 20 with no over-grant.
Applying a second heritage's whole mechanical package and unlocking its feat prerequisites is expressible by no listed field and by none of the three registries.

Gap real, fix over-grants: this is an IMMANENCE benefit, active only while your divine spark is in that ikon, and grantsFeats is unconditional and permanent. The house pattern for every other immanence benefit is a situational star naming the condition (gaze-sharp-as-steel, thousand-league-sandals, skybearers-belt, compliant-gold in situationalBonuses.ts), so the two granted feats are stated as a conditional note on the Athletics jump actions instead.

situational.when: while your divine spark is in this imbued ikon (immanence active)
situational.bonus: you gain the Powerful Leap and Quick Jump skill feats even without their prerequisites: High Jump and Long Jump each take 1 action instead of 2, and your Long Jump distance increases by 5 feet

rulings.why: situationalBonuses.ts:501 still prints Monster Hunter's +1 and no entry exists for this id, so a 16th-level ranger reads the wrong number; the fix names the supersession in its `when` and correctly leaves monster-warden's existing entry alone.

I recomputed the set from core.json (items with category 'martial' and group 'firearm' or 'bomb'): 258 items, of which the judge listed 254 and ZERO non-matching — no placeholder, no over-inclusion. mirrorCategory 'simple' is the correct reading of 'treating them as simple weapons for the purposes of proficiency'.

COMPANION_MODS.maturityFloor is a live lane (companions.ts:344-347) with no key for this id; 'advanced construct companion' is the mature rung here exactly as the shipped advanced-construct-companion / advanced-reanimated-companion entries read.

Verified in core.json: vampire-dedication and zombie-dedication both carry immunities ['death effects','disease','paralyzed','poison','sleep'] for the same 'basic undead benefits' clause; lich-dedication has no immunities field. The Soul Cage clause is narrative and is not written.

Gap real, lane wrong: COMPANION_MODS is only ever read by deriveAnimalCompanion (kinds 'animal', companions.ts:344/355/427/465) and the eidolon pass (companions.ts:784). deriveFamiliar never touches it, so a companionMod with kinds:['familiar'] would pass the applier's kind check and then sit dead. No legal field attaches a familiar ability, so what is missing is a feat-to-familiar-ability lane.
Same as lightning-rings-intervention — deriveFamiliar reads only cfg.abilities and CompanionGrant.lockedAbilities, never COMPANION_MODS, so kinds:['familiar'] is an inert write.
A property-rune slot on the character's body (with its own pick) has no field and no registry; runes are only ever etched onto inventory items.
faithful-steed is a kind 'animal' companion grant and the maturityFloor lane exists; no COMPANION_MODS key for loyal-warhorse, so the steed stays young.

Overturned: this is Craft-downtime bookkeeping the app deliberately does not model, and the sibling record with the identical clause — alchemical-crafting, 'four common 1st-level alchemical formulas to your formula book' — was already ruled NEEDS_NOTHING in judge-0 for exactly this reason (no formula book exists; only free-text craftRequirements). The snare lane exists solely because prepared snares have a play consequence.
Shape checked against first-frost, which ships innateSpells with atWill:true; guidance, message and sigil all exist in core.spells (rank 0, occult on the list) and the record carries no innateSpells.

harpoon and trident both exist in core.json as category 'martial', so mirrorCategory 'simple' matches the printed clause exactly; no FEAT_LANE_GRANTS key. The judge's stated reason for omitting the 5th-level crit spec is wrong (critSpecLevel does exist, cf. kobold-weapon-familiarity) but the omission is right anyway — the applier rejects a fix that mixes a proficiency grant with record fields.

Confirmed at derive.ts:1734-1737 — the d4-to-d6 fist upgrade is a hard-coded three-way test. unarmedTraits.stepDie is not a safe substitute: the feat has NO prerequisites, so a monk with Powerful Fist could take it and step an already-d6 fist to d8.

Verified: cathartic-mage-dedication is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES and grants its cantrip via spellFilter grantAs 'innate', so the innate entry exists and build.ts:2980-2987 applies the best spellcastingGrant profile to it — the master proficiency really lands, and the judge honestly scoped the fix to the half that is expressible.

SpellChoiceFilter really supports rank/traits/grantAs (types.ts:452-469), and the filter is exact: core.json holds precisely two rank-8 monk+focus spells, medusas-wrath and touch-of-death — the two the feat names. No focusPoolBonus is written, matching the printed text.

red-mantis-assassin-dedication is not in CASTER_ARCHETYPES; basic-red-mantis-magic grants two divine cantrips as innate, so the innate casting entry exists and a divine/cha/master spellcastingGrant raises its attack/DC as printed.

Nothing in src/rules mints a daily consumable; the sibling basic-/expert-scroll-cache were already ruled MISS with the same missing lane in judge-0 and judge-12, so the verdict is consistent and the lane really is absent.

The gelid shard archetype is absent from CASTER_ARCHETYPES while first-frost ships spellcastingGrant {arcane,cha,trained} plus innateSpells, so an arcane/cha/master grant raises the same entry one tier as printed.

spellSlotBonus only ADDS slots (perRank/byRank, build.ts ~2725) with no rank choice, no slot consumed and no restriction on what may be prepared; dailyChoices records a pick but cannot alter the slot table. A slot-conversion lane genuinely does not exist.

Gap real, but no engine work is needed: grantsFeats is a legal field, build.ts:2316-2346 adds granted feats to the SAME `feats` list that activeCasterArchetype reads at build.ts:2790, and master-summoner-spellcasting (the id CASTER_ARCHETYPES derives for summoner-dedication) exists in core.json. Pointing the duplicate record at the canonical one delivers the full 7th/8th-rank ladder and the master proficiency with no over-grant.

The maturity dropdown defaults to 'young' (Builder.tsx:1015) and only COMPANION_MODS.maturityFloor raises it (companions.ts:344-347); no key exists for this id, consistent with the incredible-* batch already filed as MISS in judge-19.
Same lane, same absence — a separate core.json record with no COMPANION_MODS key.
beastmaster-dedication grants a kind 'animal' companion and the maturityFloor lane applies; no key exists, and the note correctly flags that it covers all of the character's companions.
drake-rider-dedication is registered in FEAT_COMPANION_GRANTS as kind 'animal' (and wing-rider already modifies it as such), so the maturityFloor lane is the right one and carries no key.

mammoth-lord-dedication grants a kind 'animal' companion and its sibling incredible-megafauna-companion is already filed in COMPANION_MODS one rung up, proving the ladder is the right lane and that the mature rung is missing.
